items.title: Add reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke entry to validate.commands in lattice.config.json
items.context: One bare-string entry: node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js, placed with the other guard smokes, same pattern as retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js at line 27. Requires B-cee5 merged to main first.

happy.desc: lattice.config.json validate.commands contains exactly one new bare-string entry "node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js" placed after the retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js entry; git diff vs main shows only that config line as the sole material change (plus story metadata).

edge.desc: lattice.config.json still parses as strict JSON after the edit (node -e JSON.parse check exits 0 and produces no syntax error).

adversarial.desc: The referenced dist file packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js actually exists after building merged main (guards against wiring a path that 404s and breaks validate for everyone).

items.userSees: git diff vs main shows one added line in lattice.config.json: "node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js" directly after the retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js entry, and node -e JSON.parse on the file exits 0 silently.

verificationEvidence.note: Diff vs main shows exactly one added line in validate.commands: "node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js" inserted directly after the retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.js entry; 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), no other material change.
lattice.config.json parses as strict JSON after the edit; command printed JSON_PARSE_OK and exited 0.

Referenced dist file exists after building merged main (7069 bytes, built 2026-07-09) and runs standalone: "reviewer-scan-budget-guard: PASS (6 prompt copies clean, 4 required phrases present)", exit 0. Guards against wiring a path that 404s.

items.title: Run lattice validate and confirm the new guard command executes and passes
items.context: Full lattice validate in the story worktree after main (with B-cee5 landed) is merged in; the new command must appear in validate output and exit 0.

happy.desc: Full (non-focused) lattice validate output lists node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js as an executed command with PASS, and validate exits 0 overall.

edge.desc: The new bare-string entry has no focus tag, so a focused/fast-lane validate run (lattice validate --focus=fast) does not execute the reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke command and still exits 0, confirming the wiring does not break the fast lane while the full run does execute it.

adversarial.desc: The wired guard is genuinely capable of failing: its source contains an explicit failure path (non-zero exit on budget-exceeding scan pattern), or a seeded regression fixture triggers non-zero exit, confirming the command is not a tautological always-pass.

items.userSees: lattice validate output includes a line showing node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js executed with the guard printing "reviewer-scan-budget-guard: PASS (...)", and the overall validate run ends green with exit 0.

verificationEvidence.note: Full (non-focused) lattice validate executed the new entry as validate.commands[3] (command 4/44): log shows "ran: node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js" and "reviewer-scan-budget-guard: PASS (6 prompt copies clean, 4 required phrases present)"; overall validate exited 0. Full transcript captured in session scratchpad validate-full.log.
